title: Unit 7 Consolidation
goal: Review the time clauses that look ahead and read a short text about García Márquez and his novel El coronel no tiene quien le escriba.

items: Review en cuanto, tan pronto como, hasta que and mientras with the subjunctive, siempre que and cada vez que.
Review antes de que and después de que.
Read a text about the writer Gabriel García Márquez and his novel.
I can talk about the future with en cuanto, tan pronto como, hasta que and mientras + the present subjunctive.
I can use siempre que and cada vez que for "whenever" and "every time", and siempre que for "provided that".
I can use antes de que with the subjunctive and después de que with the indicative or the subjunctive.
I can read a short text about García Márquez and his novel El coronel no tiene quien le escriba.
